question: International Yoga Day is celebrated on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**21 June**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **International Yoga Day** is celebrated on **21st June** every year.
 
• This day was officially recognized by the United Nations General Assembly in **2014**.
 
• The proposal was first introduced by the Indian Prime Minister, **Narendra Modi**, during his speech at the UNGA.
 
• The day aims to raise awareness worldwide of the many benefits of practicing yoga.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Details
 
 
 
 

 **Origin**
 Yoga is an ancient physical, mental, and spiritual practice that originated in India.
 
 

 **Meaning**
 The word 'yoga' derives from Sanskrit and means to join or to unite, symbolizing the union of body and consciousness.
 
 

 **Significance**
 Yoga is more than just physical exercise; it has a meditative and spiritual core.
 
 

 **Types**
 Includes various styles like Hatha, Vinyasa, Ashtanga, and more, each with its unique emphasis on different postures and breathing techniques.
 
 

 **Global Impact**
 Yoga has gained immense global popularity as a holistic approach to health and well-being.
